About Brad

The guy who's been there.

13/10 Every Day

Brad has spent over 25 years in the trenches of the subcontracting world. He's not here to teach theory — he's here to share what actually works. From boots on the ground to building systems that scale, he knows exactly what it takes to go from surviving to thriving.

"Greatness is built one decision, one conversation, one day at a time."

Through Mint Management & Design, Brad works with subcontractors across North America on the things that actually move the needle: sales systems, estimating, operations, culture, and now — AI automation that actually fits how the trades work.

His mission is simple: to help you build a company — and a life — you're genuinely proud of. Not just a business that pays the bills.

The Man Behind the Mission

When Brad isn't helping subcontractors build better businesses, you'll find him exactly where it matters most — with his wife and two daughters, soaking up every moment together. Whether that's a recovery session in the sauna and cold plunge, or chasing down the next family adventure, Brad brings the same energy off the clock that he brings to his work: all in, no shortcuts.

Core Values

We don't just talk
about excellence.

These aren't words on a wall. At Mint Management, our values are the standard we hold ourselves — and our clients — to. Every day.


Build with Mint
01

13/10

Excellence isn't a moment — it's a habit. We show up every day, deliver more than what's expected, and relentlessly pursue improvement. No shortcuts. No settling. The pursuit of perfection drives us even when perfection itself is out of reach.

02

Honesty

Honesty is non-negotiable. We speak the truth — with our clients, our partners, and our team. Even when it's hard. Even when it's uncomfortable. Trust is the foundation we build on, and honesty is the first brick. There is no growth without truth.

03

Growth Mindset

Growth is a choice — one we make every day. We embrace challenges, learn from setbacks, and never settle for good enough. Every project, every conversation, every obstacle is an opportunity to get better. We stay coachable, curious, and driven.

04

Culture Driven

Culture isn't something we talk about — it's something we live. Our culture drives our standards, our relationships, and our results. We show up for each other, push each other to be better, and protect our culture because it's the engine behind every win.

Introducing
The Trades Room.

Entrepreneurship in the trades can be a lonely road. You're making big decisions, carrying the weight of your business, and more often than not — doing it without anyone around who truly gets it. Brad lived that reality for years, and he knows firsthand that having a support system of like-minded subcontractors would have been a game changer.

The Trades Room is the community he wished existed. A space where subcontractors come together to share what's working, be honest about what's not, hold each other accountable, and grow alongside people who understand the exact journey you're on. No fluff. No outsiders. Just real operators in the trades, building better businesses — together.
